title: In development
summary: Built candidates and open testing, clearly separated from live features.
body:
Recommended AA filter

Not released. The client/server candidate adds an optional shortlist beside Can Purchase, with explanations and modest starter rank targets. It considers all held classes, completed purchases, prerequisites and supporting skills or pets. Native purchasing and the full AA catalog remain available. No additional AA has been unlocked. Full server compilation, a paired client release and visible in-game QA are pending.

Cooldown duration corrections

Not released. Tested corrections prevent some reuse reductions from turning into extremely long lockouts on item clicks, Mend, Bash, Frenzy and linked spells. Fully reduced cooldowns also stay ready instead of restarting an old timer on several skills and AA completion paths. Ordinary reuse durations and effects that intentionally add time are preserved. The audit found additional shared AA, spell, discipline and item timers; separating those is still pending. Existing player cooldowns have not been cleared. A server release and in-game checks are required.

Item stacks of at least 100

Not released. Existing stackable items below 100 will gain a limit of 100; higher limits and nonstackable items stay unchanged. The migration is tested and awaits server activation. See stack limits.

Independent Monk attack cooldowns

Not released. A tested client/server correction gives Dragon Punch (Tail Rake for Iksar), Eagle Strike, Flying Kick, Kick, Round Kick and Tiger Claw their own cooldowns when you hold Monk. Using one will no longer lock the others. Each attack keeps its reuse duration, haste and earned AA adjustments; level, skill, target and range requirements still apply. Deployment and in-game combat and balance checks are pending.

No EXP penalty on normal death

Not released. The tested candidate keeps normal EXP, AA progress and level intact through normal death. Existing buff loss and other death rules remain; prior EXP losses are not refunded. Production activation and in-game checks are pending.

Normal items in the Reforging Box

The three-identical-Normal-to-Polished recipe is implemented and regression-tested for eligible ordinary gear and zone-hunt rewards. Deployment and in-game acceptance are pending. Higher box upgrades retain their four-copy cost; dungeon rewards remain separate.

Adventure Journal & Epic 0.5

The eight journal quests and Wayfarer’s Oath charm have been built but are not installed on the server. The candidate uses three shared chapters followed by Guardian, Striker, Arcanist, Warden or Binder paths. These are not available rewards.

Combat and item candidates

Broader Monk and Beastlord fist-damage formulas and some existing tiered item corrections have a tested candidate but no recorded deployment. A frozen personal casting bar remains under investigation. The separate extra-class skill, trainer and offhand correction is deployed; the reported player issue was confirmed resolved.

Ongoing checks for deployed features

Broader equipment and class combinations, stats, regeneration, ability names and Bard movement/songs still need player checks. Those are acceptance checks for installed systems, not a claim that all of them are unreleased. See Features for the available systems.
sources: docs/dungeons/deployment/production-verification.json and QA.md; deployed October 16 for live QA, owner acceptance pending
